slides.title: ClearAnswer: preserve the evidence boundary
slides.fix: Strong structure; repair false-support and confidence paths.
slides.notes: No official score. Observed snapshot; no verified official freeze receipt.

slides.title: Retain the deterministic foundation
slides.fix: These checks overlap; they are not an accuracy benchmark.
slides.notes: Public baseline and offline deterministic tests; no real model calls.

slides.title: F1 · One close number cannot validate a whole claim
slides.fix: Check every subclaim, unit and denominator.
slides.notes: Actual _build_result returns supported for the compound synthetic mismatch. The tolerance helper alone was also reproduced.

slides.title: F2 · Export must preserve uncertainty
slides.fix: Keep uncertainty attached to the evidence.
slides.notes: Injected synthetic completed-job fixture; HTTP 200 and schema-valid export. Model pipeline and browser were not run.

slides.title: F3 · A named file is not executed evidence
slides.fix: Bind supported claims to successful relevant computations.
slides.notes: Called the real result-assembly method without initializing a model client. An unqueried file name became evidence.

slides.title: F4 · Approval requires reasons and provenance
slides.fix: Preserve verdict, disposition, identity and review history.
slides.notes: Schema-valid synthetic export changed verdict and cleared human review without identity or reason. Original tool verdict remained. This is a local route test, not a remote exploit.

slides.title: F5 · Flag before sending sensitive text
slides.notes: No actual sensitive disclosure or live model call observed. Optional advice should follow event-approved data rules.

slides.title: F6 · Make manifest scope explicit
slides.fix: Bind counts and hashes to the intended population.
slides.notes: Collection-wide manifests can be valid. The issue is presenting their count as if it described the chosen release; current file_checksums does not include the manifest.

slides.title: What these checks establish
slides.notes: No hosted deployment, real browser task, accessibility certification or sealed challenge. Synthetic cases establish mechanisms, not their prevalence.

slides.title: Repair, rerun, then demonstrate the whole workflow
slides.fix: Keep the useful architecture and show concrete controls.
slides.notes: Prioritize F1–F4; then input boundaries, changed-release assumptions and role-specific user tasks. Human judges award scores.
